mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.7% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime characterized by rising new housing starts, S&P 500 returns are positive over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth compresses equity valuation multiples as the economy approaches full capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts exceed 2000 thousand units in a month, it signals strong consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime where the CPI exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, the Federal Reserve's tightening response causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment and unemployment rate signal a labor market contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
